0001| """The interactive session of Forgel Code.
0002| 
0003| The owner writes sentences. The client turns one sentence into at most one of
0004| the engine's own commands, shows what the engine answered, and re-reads the
0005| task and release state from the engine after every request and before every
0006| prompt, so progress shows up without the owner asking for a status. It never
0007| calls a model, never reads a project and never runs a check.
0008| 
0009| The session speaks the owner's language: its own wording exists in English,
0010| Russian, French and Spanish, and the owner's sentence reaches the engine
0011| unaltered so a model-composed answer arrives in that same language.
0012| """
